bugs.title: Google OAuth client_id has trailing newline causing Google Error 400: invalid_request
bugs.steps:
1. Go to /apps
2. Click Connect on Gmail
3. Redirected to Google OAuth URL
bugs.actual: URL contains client_id=...apps.googleusercontent.com%0A which Google rejects with Error 400: Parameter value is not valid: client_id
